one_liner_zh: 百事本季EPS大幅低於預期16.14%，恐含減損或重整費用，獲利承壓。
one_liner_en: PepsiCo missed EPS by 16.14% this quarter, likely on impairment or restructuring charges, pressuring earnings.
ai_view_zh: 訊號偏負向：16.14%的EPS不及預期幅度顯著，多半牽涉一次性減損或重整費用，須拆解調整後數字才能判斷核心獲利能力。短期股價恐承壓，市場關注是否下修全年指引。中期則看量能與北美零食事業能否回穩。追蹤指標：調整後EPS與一次性項目拆解、有機營收成長、北美量能、毛利率，以及管理層全年EPS與成本撙節計畫的指引。
ai_view_en: Signal is mildly negative: a 16.14% EPS miss is sizable and likely involves one-off impairment or restructuring charges, so the adjusted figure is needed to judge core profitability. Near-term the stock may face pressure as the market watches for full-year guidance cuts. Mid-term hinges on volume and North America snacks stabilizing. Track: adjusted EPS and one-off bridge, organic revenue growth, North America volumes, gross margin, and management guidance on full-year EPS and cost-savings programs.
highlights_zh: EPS 1.85美元，明顯低於預期2.21美元，負向驚喜16.14%
營收293.4億美元，反映含旺季的較大基期
核心零食與飲料品牌組合仍具長期防禦性
highlights_en: EPS of $1.85 came in well below the $2.21 estimate, a 16.14% negative surprise
Revenue of $29.34B reflects a larger base including peak season
Core snacks and beverage brand portfolio retains long-term defensiveness
risks_zh: EPS大幅不及預期，須釐清是否為減損、重整或匯率拖累
營收年增資料缺失，成長能見度受限
量能疲弱與成本壓力可能延續至後續季度
risks_en: The sizable EPS miss requires clarity on impairment, restructuring, or FX drag
Missing revenue YoY limits growth visibility
Volume softness and cost pressure could persist into later quarters
